subject.title: feat(android): read-only workspace Files browser with preview and share

question: Should the Android Files browser be accepted once https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100738 lands, or must it wait for a higher-scope or dedicated workspace file-read authorization model?
rationale: The Android implementation is tied to a new arbitrary workspace read/preview surface, so the safe merge order depends on maintainer security intent for the underlying Gateway RPC.

options.title: Approve After Gateway Boundary Is Fixed
options.body: Refresh the generated artifacts here, land the Gateway RPC only with the approved authorization boundary, then retarget and merge the Android surface.

options.title: Accept Read-Scope Mobile Browsing
options.body: Proceed only if security owners explicitly accept that existing read-scoped operator clients may browse and share previewable workspace files.

options.title: Pause Android Surface
options.body: Keep this PR open but paused until the broader workspace file API direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve After Gateway Boundary Is Fixed
recommendation.body: Refresh the generated artifacts here, land the Gateway RPC only with the approved authorization boundary, then retarget and merge the Android surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They own this protected PR and the linked feature request and have recent Android/docs history in this area.
